DZA.note: Regulator audit of SIM subscriber identification; no authentication service stated.
Nothing on civil register and ID link.
Cites law 18-07 only in the preamble; states no standing, authority, regulations or application.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs the ID system.
SIM subscriber database is not a public register keyed on the ID.
Nothing on the national ID system's status, biometrics or certification.
Operators keep a NIN or ID-document number and an ID copy per subscriber; no check against the national ID database stated.
A regulator's decision on mobile subscriber (SIM) identification, which is not an identity law.
